questions.question: Yangi Linux server oldingizda (VPS). Birinchi 15 daqiqada nimalar qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Update, alohida sudo user, SSH key-only + root login o'chirish, firewall (faqat 22/80/443), vaqt sinxronizatsiyasi, hostname/timezone, avtomatik security update, monitoring agent.

questions.question: Serverga qanday ulanasiz va fayl ko'chirasiz? `ssh`, `scp`, `rsync` farqi.
questions.explanation: `ssh user@host` — masofaviy shell. `scp` — oddiy nusxa. `rsync` — faqat farqni yuboradi, uzilsa davom etadi, katta/takroriy ko'chirish uchun eng yaxshisi.

questions.question: Server holatini tez tekshirish: CPU, RAM, disk, qaysi portlar ochiq — qaysi komandalar?
questions.explanation: `uptime`/`top`/`htop` — CPU/load, `free -h` — RAM, `df -h` — disk, `ss -tlnp` — tinglayotgan portlar, `systemctl --failed` — yiqilgan service'lar.

questions.question: Service'ni boshqarish: ishga tushirish, to'xtatish, qayta yuklash, log ko'rish.
questions.explanation: `systemctl start|stop|restart|reload|status|enable` va `journalctl -u`. `reload` — config'ni process'ni o'ldirmay qayta o'qish, `restart` — to'liq qayta ishga tushirish.

questions.question: Cron: vazifani muntazam ishga tushirish. Sintaksis va keng tarqalgan xatolar.
questions.explanation: `crontab -e` — `min hour day month weekday command`. Xatolar: PATH boshqa (to'liq yo'l yoz), muhit o'zgaruvchilari yo'q, output yo'qoladi (log'ga yo'naltir), `%` belgisi maxsus.

questions.question: Server'da fayl va papka huquqlari: ilova 'Permission denied' bermoqda. Qanday tuzatasiz?
questions.explanation: Kim bilan ishlayapti (`ps -o user`), fayl kimniki (`ls -l`), kerakli minimal huquq ber (`chown`/`chmod`). `chmod 777` — yechim emas, xavfsizlik teshigi.

questions.question: Process'ni to'xtatish: `kill`, `kill -9`, `pkill`. SIGTERM va SIGKILL farqi?
questions.explanation: SIGTERM (15) — iltimos: process ushlab, resurslarni yopib, chiqadi. SIGKILL (9) — kernel darhol o'ldiradi, tozalash yo'q. Avval TERM, kutib, keyin KILL.

questions.question: SSH uzilsa ham uzoq ishlaydigan komanda (migratsiya, backup) qanday ishga tushiriladi?
questions.explanation: `tmux`/`screen` — sessiya serverda qoladi, qayta ulanib davom etasan. Bir martalik: `nohup cmd &`. Doimiy ilova uchun esa systemd.

questions.question: Log'dan kerakli ma'lumot topish: `tail`, `grep`, `less`, `awk`. Misol: access.log'da eng ko'p so'rov yuborgan IP'lar.
questions.explanation: `tail -f` — jonli, `grep` — filtr, `less +F` — ko'rish, `awk`/`sort`/`uniq -c` — hisoblash.

questions.question: Paket o'rnatish va yangilash: `apt`/`dnf`. `apt update` va `apt upgrade` farqi?
questions.explanation: `update` — paket ro'yxatini yangilaydi (hech narsa o'rnatmaydi), `upgrade` — o'rnatilganlarni yangilaydi. Production'da versiyani nazorat qil (pin/hold).

questions.question: Domen serverga ishlamayapti. DNS'ni qanday tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: `dig`/`nslookup` bilan A/AAAA/CNAME yozuvini tekshir, to'g'ri IP'mi, TTL. Server o'zi qaysi DNS'dan foydalanayotganini `/etc/resolv.conf`/`resolvectl` da ko'r.

questions.question: Port ochiq, lekin brauzerdan sayt ochilmayapti. Qayerdan boshlaysiz?
questions.explanation: Ichkaridan tashqariga: ilova ishlayaptimi (`systemctl status`), qaysi IP'da tinglayapti (`ss -tlnp` — 127.0.0.1 yoki 0.0.0.0), lokal `curl`, firewall/SG, DNS, TLS.

questions.question: Firewall: `ufw`, `iptables`, `nftables`, cloud Security Group — farqi va qaysini ishlatasiz?
questions.explanation: Hammasi oxir-oqibat kernel netfilter. iptables — eski CLI, nftables — yangi backend/syntax, ufw/firewalld — ustidagi qulay frontend. Cloud SG — host'dan tashqarida, network darajasida. Defense in depth: ikkalasi ham.

questions.question: Server diski 100% to'ldi, ilova yiqildi. Qadamma-qadam nima qilasiz?
questions.explanation: `df -h` (qaysi FS), `df -i` (inode), `du`/`ncdu` bilan katta joyni top, o'chirilgan-lekin-ochiq fayllar (`lsof +L1`), log'larni truncate/rotate. Keyin root cause: logrotate, retention, alert.

questions.question: Load average 30, server sekin. CPU 8 core. Qanday tahlil qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Load = runnable + uninterruptible (D state, odatda I/O) task'lar. Avval CPU'mi yoki I/O'mi aniqla: `top`/`vmstat`/`iostat`/`pidstat`. 'USE' metodi: utilization, saturation, errors.

questions.question: `ulimit`, `nofile`, `Too many open files` — sabab va to'g'ri sozlash.
questions.explanation: Har process'da fd limiti bor (default soft 1024). Ko'p connection'li server tez tugatadi. systemd service'da `LimitNOFILE`, shell'da `/etc/security/limits.conf`. Avval leak yo'qligini tekshir.

questions.question: Log boshqaruvi: journald, rsyslog, logrotate. Log server diskini to'ldirmasligi uchun nima qilasiz?
questions.explanation: journald — systemd binary log (`journalctl`), rsyslog — klassik matn/forwarding, logrotate — fayllarni aylantirish/siqish/o'chirish. Limit qo'y, markaziy log tizimiga jo'nat (Loki/ELK).

questions.question: Ilovani serverda qanday ishga tushirasiz: `nohup`, `screen`, systemd service? Production uchun to'g'risi?
questions.explanation: systemd: avtomatik restart, boot'da start, log (journald), resurs limitlari, alohida user, sandboxing. nohup/screen — vaqtinchalik ish uchun, production emas.

questions.question: Server monitoringi: minimal nima kuzatiladi va alert qanday bo'lishi kerak?
questions.explanation: USE (CPU, memory, disk, network: utilization/saturation/errors) + ilova RED (rate, errors, duration). node_exporter + Prometheus + Grafana + Alertmanager. Alert — simptomga (SLO), har alert harakatga undasin.

questions.question: Swap, OOM killer: server xotirasi tugasa nima bo'ladi va qanday himoyalanasiz?
questions.explanation: RAM tugasa kernel swap'ga yozadi (sekin), u ham tugasa OOM killer eng 'og'ir' process'ni o'ldiradi (ko'pincha DB yoki ilova). Himoya: `MemoryMax` (cgroup), monitoring, `oom_score_adj`, to'g'ri o'lchamlash.

questions.question: Nginx `502 Bad Gateway` va `504 Gateway Timeout` — farqi va diagnostika.
questions.explanation: 502 — upstream'ga ulanib bo'lmadi yoki noto'g'ri javob (ilova o'chgan, noto'g'ri port/socket, crash). 504 — ulandi, lekin javob `proxy_read_timeout` ichida kelmadi (sekin query, deadlock).

questions.question: fail2ban va SSH hujumlari: auth.log'da minglab xato login. Qanday himoyalanasiz?
questions.explanation: Asosiy himoya — parolsiz (key-only) login; shunda brute-force xavfsiz, faqat shovqin. Qo'shimcha: fail2ban (IP ban), SSH'ni VPN/bastion ortiga yashirish, `AllowUsers`.

questions.question: Let's Encrypt sertifikat muddati o'tib ketdi, sayt ishlamayapti. Qanday tuzatish va oldini olish?
questions.explanation: `certbot renew` + web server reload. Sabab odatda: renew timer ishlamagan, 80-port yopiq (HTTP-01), DNS o'zgargan, reload qilinmagan. Oldini olish: avtomatik renew + deploy hook + muddat monitoringi.

questions.question: Server'ning tashqi API'ga ulanishi sekin/uziladi. Network'ni qanday debug qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Bosqichlarga ajrat: DNS -> TCP connect -> TLS -> birinchi bayt -> transfer. `curl -w` timing beradi; `mtr` yo'l, `tcpdump` paketlar, `ss` connection holati.

questions.question: Inode, hardlink, ochiq fayl: `df` disk bo'sh desa ham 'No space left on device'. Sabab?
questions.explanation: Inode tugagan (millionlab mayda fayl: session, cache, mail queue) yoki boshqa mount to'lgan. `df -i` bilan tekshir.

questions.question: Server'da Docker bilan ishlash: container log'lari diskni to'ldirdi, restart policy, resurs limitlari.
questions.explanation: Default `json-file` log driver cheksiz o'sadi — `max-size`/`max-file` qo'y. `restart: unless-stopped`. `--memory`/`--cpus` bilan limitla, aks holda bitta container butun server'ni yeydi.

questions.question: Backup'ni qanday tekshirasiz? 'Backup bor' degani tiklay olamiz degani emasmi?
questions.explanation: Yo'q. Backup faqat restore sinalgandagina bor. Muntazam avtomatik restore test, checksum, RPO/RTO o'lchash, backup alohida account/joyda va immutable.

questions.question: `sudo` va root: nega root bilan ishlamaslik kerak? sudo'ni qanday cheklaysiz?
questions.explanation: Root — xatoning narxi cheksiz va audit yo'q. sudo — har buyruq log'da, kerakli joydagina ko'tariladi, alohida user'larga minimal ruxsat berish mumkin.

questions.question: Server qayta boot bo'lgandan keyin ilova/mount ishlamay qoldi. Nimalarni tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Service `enable` qilinmagan, `After=network-online.target` yo'q, fstab'dagi mount (UUID o'zgargan/`nofail` yo'q), `/tmp` tozalangan, iptables saqlanmagan, `sysctl` faqat runtime'da berilgan.

questions.question: `strace`, `lsof`, `tcpdump`: process 'osilib qoldi'. Ichida nima bo'layotganini qanday ko'rasiz?
questions.explanation: `strace -p` — qaysi syscall'da kutyapti (read, futex, connect), `lsof -p` — qaysi fayl/socket ochiq, `/proc/<pid>/stack`, til vositalari (Go: `SIGQUIT` goroutine dump, pprof).

questions.question: Bitta serverda zero-downtime deploy qanday qilinadi (Kubernetes'siz)?
questions.explanation: Reverse proxy (nginx) ortida eski va yangi versiyani yonma-yon ko'tar, health check o'tgach trafikni yangi'ga o'tkaz, eskisini graceful to'xtat. Yoki symlink release + graceful reload. Rollback = eski symlink.

questions.question: Server patching va reboot: kernel update'dan keyin reboot kerakmi? Production'da qanday rejalashtirasiz?
questions.explanation: Kernel/glibc/openssl yangilansa — eski kod xotirada qoladi, reboot yoki service restart kerak. `needrestart`, `/var/run/reboot-required`. Rolling: bitta-bitta, LB'dan chiqarib (drain), tekshirib.

questions.question: Pet vs cattle; configuration drift. Serverlarni qanday boshqarish kerak?
questions.explanation: Pet — qo'lda sozlangan, noyob, davolanadi. Cattle — bir xil, avtomatik yaratiladi, buzilsa almashtiriladi. Drift — qo'lda o'zgarishlar bilan serverlar farqlanishi. Yechim: IaC (Terraform) + config management (Ansible) yoki immutable image (Packer).

questions.question: Server tarmoqdan javob bermayapti (SSH ham). Qanday tiklaysiz?
questions.explanation: Qatlamma-qatlam: tarmoqmi (ping/LB/SG), host tirikmi (cloud console, serial console), kernel panic/OOM/disk full? Out-of-band kirish (VNC/serial/IPMI). Tiklash, keyin postmortem.

questions.question: Kernel tuning (`sysctl`): yuqori yuklamali web server uchun qaysi parametrlar va qachon tegish kerak?
questions.explanation: Faqat o'lchab, muammo ko'rinsa. Tez-tez tegiladiganlar: `net.core.somaxconn`, `tcp_max_syn_backlog`, `ip_local_port_range`, `tcp_tw_reuse`, `fs.file-max`, `vm.swappiness`, `nf_conntrack_max`.

questions.question: Serverdagi secret'lar (DB parol, API key) qayerda va qanday saqlanadi?
questions.explanation: Kodda va git'da emas. Minimal: `EnvironmentFile` 0600 huquq bilan, root/service user o'qiydi. Yaxshiroq: secret manager (Vault, AWS SSM/Secrets Manager) + runtime'da olish, rotation, audit.

questions.question: Bitta serverdan yuqori mavjudlikka (HA) o'tish: minimal arxitektura qanday?
questions.explanation: ≥2 stateless ilova serveri + load balancer (health check bilan) + state alohida (managed DB replika bilan, obyekt storage). Session server'da emas (Redis/JWT). Turli AZ.

questions.question: Server/servisni boshqa serverga (yoki cloud'ga) downtime'siz ko'chirish rejasi.
questions.explanation: Inventarizatsiya -> yangi muhitni IaC bilan qur -> data replikatsiya (DB replica, rsync) -> DNS TTL pasaytir -> sinov -> qisqa write-freeze yoki dual-write -> cutover -> monitoring -> rollback rejasi -> eski serverni kechiktirib o'chir.

questions.question: Server hardening: kernel/OS darajasida nima qilinadi (CIS benchmark misolida)?
questions.explanation: Hujum yuzasini kamaytir: keraksiz paket/service/port yo'q, minimal huquq, avtomatik security patch, audit, faqat kerakli outbound, kernel parametrlari, MAC (SELinux/AppArmor), mount option'lar.

questions.question: Bastion/jump host va SSH tunnel: private subnetdagi DB'ga xavfsiz qanday ulanasiz?
questions.explanation: DB internetga ochilmaydi. Bastion (yoki SSM/VPN) orqali `ssh -J` yoki port forward (`-L`). Audit, qisqa muddatli kirish, MFA.

questions.question: Capacity planning: server qachon kichik bo'lib qoladi? Qanday o'lchab, bashorat qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Hozirgi baseline (p95 CPU, RAM, disk o'sishi, IOPS, connection) + o'sish tendensiyasi + load test bilan bitta server chegarasi (qaysi resurs birinchi to'yinadi). Headroom 30–50%.

questions.question: Server xavfsizligi buzilgan deb gumon qilinmoqda (noma'lum process, CPU 100% — miner). Nima qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Shoshilib o'chirma — avval izolyatsiya (network), dalil saqla (snapshot, xotira, process list), keyin tahlil. Buzilgan server tozalanmaydi — qaytadan quriladi, barcha secret'lar rotate qilinadi.

questions.question: Production serverda incident: sayt sekin, 5xx o'syapti. Birinchi 10 daqiqada nima qilasiz (on-call)?
questions.explanation: Ta'sirni bahola, kommunikatsiya boshla, yaqindagi o'zgarishni tekshir (deploy/config) — rollback birinchi variant. Diagnostikadan oldin mitigation. Keyin root cause, postmortem.

questions.question: Immutable infrastructure: SSH'siz server'lar g'oyasi. Qachon to'g'ri, qachon ortiqcha?
questions.explanation: Server o'zgartirilmaydi — yangi image (Packer/container) quriladi va almashtiriladi. Plyus: drift yo'q, bashorat qilinadigan, rollback oson, xavfsizlik. Minus: build pipeline, observability yetuk bo'lishi shart, kichik jamoaga og'ir.

questions.question: Senariy: serverda `fork: retry: Resource temporarily unavailable`, SSH ham qiyin ochilyapti. Sabab va yechim?
questions.explanation: PID yoki thread limiti tugagan (fork bomb, thread leak, zombie'lar, `ulimit -u` yoki cgroup `pids.max`, `kernel.pid_max`). Mavjud sessiyadan yoki konsoldan aybdor jarayonni topib to'xtatish; keyin limitlar va leak sababini tuzatish.

questions.question: Senariy: server soati 3 daqiqa orqada qoldi — qanday muammolar chiqadi va qanday tuzatiladi?
questions.explanation: TLS (sertifikat 'hali kuchga kirmagan'), JWT/token (nbf/exp), AWS imzolangan so'rovlar (`RequestTimeTooSkewed`, 5 daqiqa), Kerberos, log/trace vaqt tartibi, distributed lock'lar va cron buziladi. chrony/NTP'ni tekshirish; katta farqni `makestep` bilan tuzatish, ishlayotgan tizimda sakrash ehtiyotkorlik bilan.
